# G-01 ratchet: test/letflow/security_probe/g01_route_role_matrix_test.exs
#
# The matrix test's violations must equal these lines exactly. A new violation
# fails the test (a new hole, or a new narrowing to review); a line that no
# longer occurs fails it too (remove it: the ratchet only tightens).
# Line format: RULE CALLER METHOD PATH (rules: docs/security-probes/G-01.md).
#
# M1 (denied caller not given the canonical denial), M2 (denied request
# wrote), M4 (foreign id answered unlike a missing id), M5 (A wrote B), M6
# (answer names B): none today. Never add a line for these rules without an
# owner decision: each one is a security hole.

# --- M3: a second gate narrows the golden (reviewed T-2627, not a hole) ------
# Handler gates after `Letflow.Plugs.Authorize` answer the canonical 403 to a
# caller the role golden allows. Example: `Letflow.Routers.ApprovalRules`
# `guarded/2` needs an interactive sign-in (`credential == :oidc`) and a
# tenant-wide grant (`Letflow.Api.Scope.require_tenant_wide/2`); the probe's
# callers are API tokens. Over-denial, not over-grant; the allowed path of
# these routes is outside this probe (docs/security-probes/G-01.md, limits).
M3 A_STOREKEEPER POST /entities/records/:entity_type/import
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN DELETE /identity/shared-stock-access
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN GET /approval-rules
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN GET /identity/shared-stock-access
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN GET /ledger-settings
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN GET /tenant/role-grants
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN POST /identity/shared-stock-access
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN POST /tenant/modules/:module_id/reactivate
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN POST /tenant/modules/:module_id/uninstall
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN PUT /approval-rules/:definition_name/:node_id
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN PUT /identity/users/:id/service-principal
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN PUT /ledger-settings/:registration
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN PUT /tenant/role-grants
M3 A_TENANT_ADMIN PUT /tenant/scope-enforcement
M3 P_PLATFORM_ADMIN DELETE /identity/shared-stock-access
M3 P_PLATFORM_ADMIN GET /identity/shared-stock-access
M3 P_PLATFORM_ADMIN GET /tenant/role-grants
M3 P_PLATFORM_ADMIN POST /identity/shared-stock-access
M3 P_PLATFORM_ADMIN PUT /identity/users/:id/service-principal
M3 P_PLATFORM_ADMIN PUT /tenant/role-grants
M3 P_PLATFORM_ADMIN PUT /tenant/scope-enforcement
